before.agentText:
Readsrc/desktop/ui/desktop-app.tsxReadsplit-view/split-view-math.tsSearched forSplitView · 6 resultsThe shell already owns one SplitView for the sidebars, so I'd keep panes in a second, nested group. Each pane stores a fraction of the chat area rather than a pixel width, which means:Resizing the window keeps every pane's proportions.A new pane takes its share from the one it was dropped beside.The focused pane is lit by --desktop-light-edge; the others step back slightly.
